## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and how this change helps. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Checks

List the checks you ran and their results. Note anything that failed or wasn't run.
For skill instruction changes, explain how you checked the affected behavior and
preserved rules, exceptions, examples, and approval requirements.

Use made-up examples and leave private skill text, credentials, personal
information, and raw local review records out of the pull request.
